$comment: Schema for data/reviews.json. The site renders a review only when consentGiven is true. Leave the file as [] until a traveller has agreed in writing. Do not add sample reviews.
title: Trip N Travel reviews

name.description: First name and initial only, for example Aisha K.

trip.description: Destination and type of trip. Do not name a supplier.

date.description: ISO date the trip took place or the review was given.

consentGiven.description: True only when there is a record of permission to publish.
